name: Wood Fryberg
source:
The player character. 

A widowed father living in a corner of Volcano Kingdom, raising his only daughter alone after the passing of his wife, Luca. Once a knight of some renown, his only goal in life now is to see his daughter grow up strong and hale. While he dreams of a tranquil life where she's called "a normal girl," his daughter has decided to take up a chivalric path. He watches over her while offering whatever support he can. 

[Taken from [url=https://volcano-princess.com/en/index.html]English Official site[/url]]
